entities.summary: Mohammed Hassan Al-Jundi ‎(1939-2017) was a major Moroccan figure of art, theater and cinema. He was an author, film director and actor. He is considered one of the most famous and popular actors in Morocco and the Arab world. He has excelled in historical roles and is also regarded as one of the main pillars of Moroccan theater.
